target.title: fix(media): accept repeated content-length when values match
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where media and plugin paths that rely on shared Content-Length parsing could reject otherwise valid responses when response headers expose repeated matching Content-Length values as a comma-joined header value.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared media parser now parses each comma-separated Content-Length member with the existing digit and safe-integer checks, then accepts the header only when every parsed value agrees. Malformed, unsafe, empty, or conflicting values still fail before body reads, so callers keep their existing byte-cap decisions in one owner-local helper.

## User Impact

Users and plugin/channel developers are less likely to see valid media, auth, or download responses fail solely because an upstream server or proxy repeated an identical Content-Length header. Conflicting or malformed headers are still rejected.

## Evidence

- Claim proved: at current head `fac36034f57d4812f2d5e0db5f010c2cb5bd519a`, the real media fetch path accepts a response whose `Content-Length` value is `5, 5`, reads the 5-byte body, and still rejects a conflicting `5, 6` value before body handling.
- Real media path proof: `node --import tsx --input-type=module` with a local raw HTTP responder and `readRemoteMediaBuffer` from `src/media/fetch.ts` passed with this terminal output:

  ```text
  ok repeated matching content-length -> bytes=5 text=hello
  bad conflicting content-length -> MediaFetchError: Failed to fetch media from http://127.0.0.1:59621/bad: invalid content-length header: 5, 6
  ```

- Focused regression test: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/media-core/src/content-length.test.ts` passed: 1 test file, 4 tests.
- Committed diff hygiene: `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passed.
- Review proof: `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode branch --base upstream/main` passed with `autoreview clean: no accepted/actionable findings reported`.
- Scope checked: `git diff --name-only upstream/main...HEAD` contains only `packages/media-core/src/content-length.ts` and `packages/media-core/src/content-length.test.ts`.
